mapper.select:
select i.item_id, i.combination_id, i.match_id, i.odds_id, m.match_code, i.selection_type, i.odds_value_snapshot, round(i.manual_weight_snapshot / 10000, 4) as manual_weight_snapshot, round(i.applied_weight / 10000, 4) as applied_weight, i.selection_reason, i.weight_rationale, i.evidence_refs, i.counter_evidence_refs, i.item_sort, ht.team_name as home_team_name, at.team_name as away_team_name, m.match_time, m.match_result, m.match_venue, concat(coalesce(ht.team_name, ''), ' vs ', coalesce(at.team_name, ''), ' ', date_format(m.match_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) as match_summary, i.create_by, i.create_time from fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination_item i left join fx67ll_dortmund_match m on m.match_id = i.match_id left join fx67ll_dortmund_team ht on ht.team_id = m.home_team_id left join fx67ll_dortmund_team at on at.team_id = m.away_team_id where i.combination_id = #{combinationId}
order by case when i.item_sort is null or i.item_sort = 0 then 1 else 0 end asc, case when i.item_sort is null or i.item_sort = 0 then 0 else i.item_sort end asc, STR_TO_DATE(i.create_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s") desc, i.item_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination_item (combination_id, match_id, odds_id, selection_type, odds_value_snapshot, manual_weight_snapshot, applied_weight, selection_reason, weight_rationale, evidence_refs, counter_evidence_refs, item_sort, create_by, create_time) values (#{combinationId}, #{matchId}, #{oddsId}, #{selectionType}, #{oddsValueSnapshot}, round(#{manualWeightSnapshot} * 10000), round(#{appliedWeight} * 10000), #{selectionReason}, #{weightRationale}, #{evidenceRefs}, #{counterEvidenceRefs}, #{itemSort}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: delete i from fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination_item i join fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination c on c.combination_id = i.combination_id where c.generation_id = #{generationId}
